messages.en: I got a threatening message on WhatsApp, and now I'm feeling a bit scared.
Don't delete that message. I can go with you to file a police report if you want.

senses.en_definition: An English conjunction used to connect words, phrases, or clauses, usually corresponding to dan in Malay.

messages.en: I'll get the food and drinks together. It'll be easier that way. Can you grab some ice?
Sure, I'll take care of the ice. Want me to pick up some cups too?
How's your day been so far?
Good, thank God. I'm really enjoying this song.

senses.en_definition: Strange or unusual; different from what is normally seen, heard, or expected.

messages.en: This message is really strange. They say I've won a prize, but I haven't entered any competitions.
Don't tap that link yet. Check the sender's number. Do you recognize it?
